name: Public attention / information demand
product_relevance_reason: Attention volume bears on trend discovery, as a proxy. It is not demand, not customers and not willingness to pay.
exact_world_state_unit: varies by apparatus, and that is the problem

routes.note: A content-request count is produced by Wikimedia's own request logs. Only Wikimedia is positioned to produce it.
A search is a different event from a content request. Two apparatuses measuring different events are not two witnesses.

same_proposition_reason: §17 and §20 name this directly. Wikipedia pageviews and search volume are not two measurements of one event; nor are Stack Exchange questions and Wikipedia views. Mission 1.47 already established the second pair as COMPLEMENTARY_NOT_CORROBORATING on this repository's own corpus.
